liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it incandescent, with Branford Marsalis sitting in; Jerry's count-off of the song is highlighted as a notable moment [19][27]
- **Eyes of the World** (2 reviews): Branford Marsalis opens it up with hot playing; Reviewer praises the Eyes with Branford Marsalis [19][28]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Reviewer names this version as a personal favorite [21]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Phil's bass playing sounds like Flea's thumb-popping style [19]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Fans in line expected another one like the year before, and this one included a second verse [20]
- **Drums** (1 other source): Hamza El-Din performed during the Drums segment [2]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-12-31.prefm.gans-bucholtz-abrams.GEMS.90102.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 25 songs; 208 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd90-12-31.sbd-satellitefeed.hall.1688.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 191 min; rated 4.66/5 by 29 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard recording exceptionally crisp; Reviewer rates the recording's sound top notch, though the vocals are less impressive [20][27]
- **gd1990-12-31.140734.set2.akg.c42.ambient.mics.gans.miller.clugston.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 12 songs; 120 min [12]. Said about its sound: Odd sounds around Midnight Countdown and the start of Not Fade Away; pops throughout are not recording flaws [12]
- **gd1990-12-31.127388.nak300.bowen.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 186 min [2]

## Around the show

- KPFA in Berkeley broadcast the show, and fans blasted it from huge speakers across the parking lot [17]
- Branford Marsalis opened the show with Kevin Eubanks on guitar, then played with the Dead for the second time [20]
- First New Year's run after losing Brent; Bruce and Branford Marsalis helped fill the gap [22]
- Reviewer found the Branford set so good they'd have been happy leaving afterward, and praises Kevin Eubanks [22]
- Reviewer thought the Branford set was nearly as good as the Dead's own [23]
- Reviewer arrived late with bad seats, then made their way down to Jerry's side of the floor [24]
- The opening with Branford Marsalis is singled out as the standout part of the show [25]
- The show closed a tour year of 83 shows, 17 states, six countries and a band member's death [27]
- Reviewer ranks it among the top three 1990 Eyes, alongside 3/29 and 6/10 [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-12-31.prefm.gans-bucholtz-abrams.GEMS.90102.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bob Abrams; source: Pre-FM > DAT > CD > EAC > CD > EAC > FLAC [1]
- **gd90-12-31.sbd-satellitefeed.hall.1688.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1990-12-31.140734.set2.akg.c42.ambient.mics.gans.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Master Audience 4 Track Hi-Fi VHS; AKG C42 mics located mid-side of soundboard > 1st gen Hi-Fi VHS (dubbed by David Gans, January 1991) [12]
- **gd1990-12-31.127388.nak300.bowen.flac16**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Jeff Bowen; source: Source: Nakamichi CM-300 CP-4 Shotguns > Sony TC-153SD (TDK SA-X Masters); Cassette Masters Transferred: Sony TC-D5M > HHb CDR 800 PRO Via Analog i/o > CD… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-12-31 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1990-12-31-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [30]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 31, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/december-31-1990) [31]
